title: LinkedRecord
description: A typed, versioned attachment keyed to a Unit, Claim or Definition by identifier — carrying its own lifecycle so the core object is never hostage to it. The extension point: compensation, obligations, endorsements and scores all live here, never in the core.

type.description: Defined by a profile, never by the core. The core stores the payload opaquely.

payload.description: Shape is the profile's business. Validated against the profile's own schema by whatever service owns that profile.

state.description: The record's own lifecycle, independent of the object it is keyed to.
